newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 4.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 4.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
** After surging 65 points over the past four trading days, the Dow Jones industrial average slipped 1.12 points to 5,932.85 on Thursday.

** The European Union said on Thursday it would bring Indonesia to the World Trade Organisation (WTO) over the country's national car policy. Japan and the United States have already said they will complain to the WTO on the policy.
** The Jakarta composite index rose 0.48 point, or 0.08 percent, to close at 589.79 on Thursday with some speculative buying of second- and third-liners.
** On Friday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,323.75/24.25 in early trading against an opening of 2,324.00/24.50.
** Glass manufacturer Mulia Industri on market talk of a possible private placement.
** Duta Pertiwi on market talk the property firm was likely to issue convertible bonds for further expansion.
** Duta Anggada Realty on fresh market talk that the property firm was in negotiations with another new foreign property firm following a previously announced venture.
